From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the LORD his God,
Then Jonah made prayer to the Lord his God from the inside of the fish, and said,
約拿在魚腹中禱告耶和華─他的神，
saying: “In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered me. From the belly of Sheol I called for help, and You heard my voice.
In my trouble I was crying to the Lord, and he gave me an answer; out of the deepest underworld I sent up a cry, and you gave ear to my voice.
說：我遭遇患難求告耶和華，你就應允我；從陰間的深處呼求，你就俯聽我的聲音。
For You cast me into the deep, into the heart of the seas, and the current swirled about me; all Your breakers and waves swept over me.
For you have put me down into the deep, into the heart of the sea; and the river was round about me; all your waves and your rolling waters went over me.
你將我投下深淵，就是海的深處；大水環繞我，你的波浪洪濤都漫過我身。
At this, I said, ‘I have been banished from Your sight; yet I will look once more toward Your holy temple.’
And I said, I have been sent away from before your eyes; how may I ever again see your holy Temple?
我說：我從你眼前雖被驅逐，我仍要仰望你的聖殿。
The waters engulfed me to take my life; the watery depths closed around me; the seaweed wrapped around my head.
The waters were circling round me, even to the neck; the deep was about me; the sea-grass was twisted round my head.
諸水環繞我，幾乎淹沒我；深淵圍住我；海草纏繞我的頭。
To the roots of the mountains I descended; the earth beneath me barred me in forever! But You raised my life from the pit, O LORD my God!
I went down to the bases of the mountains; as for the earth, her walls were about me for ever: but you have taken up my life from the underworld, O Lord my God.
我下到山根，地的門將我永遠關住。耶和華─我的神啊，你卻將我的性命從坑中救出來。
As my life was fading away, I remembered the LORD. My prayer went up to You, to Your holy temple.
When my soul in me was overcome, I kept the memory of the Lord: and my prayer came in to you, into your holy Temple.
我心在我裡面發昏的時候，我就想念耶和華。我的禱告進入你的聖殿，達到你的面前。
Those who cling to worthless idols forsake His loving devotion.
The worshippers of false gods have given up their only hope.
那信奉虛無之神的人，離棄憐愛他們的主；
But I, with the voice of thanksgiving, will sacrifice to You. I will fulfill what I have vowed. Salvation is from the LORD!”
But I will make an offering to you with the voice of praise; I will give effect to my oaths. Salvation is the Lord's.
但我必用感謝的聲音獻祭與你。我所許的願，我必償還。救恩出於耶和華。
And the LORD commanded the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.
And at the Lord's order, the fish sent Jonah out of its mouth on to the dry land.
耶和華吩咐魚，魚就把約拿吐在旱地上。
